turns.text: I just saw the notice from the playhouse about our improv class moving off Tuesday nights. I really do not appreciate that you stayed silent and left me to find that out on my own, because that is something I should have heard from you the second it came in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
You are right, and I am sorry. The Alder Street Playhouse email (em_0028, subject "Improv class night change") arrived today at some point and I did not catch it or bring it to you. That should not have happened — you should have heard it from me, not found it yourself.

The body just says:

> *The next block of improv class is moving off Tuesday nights. Please check the new class night before making plans for the term.*

No new night is named in the email. They ask you to check rather than telling you outright.

Do you want me to call the playhouse office now to find out what the new night is, or send a reply asking? Either way — tell me and I will get it sorted.
